content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: WBPSC has announced recruitment for Industrial Development Officer positions in the Directorate of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises under the Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles, Government of West Bengal.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in the Industrial Development Officer post must satisfy the educational qualifications, age requirements and other eligibility conditions prescribed by WBPSC. For reference, the previous WBPSC IDO recruitment accepted candidates with a degree from a recognised university or a diploma in Engineering or Technology from a recognised institution. Knowledge of Bengali was also among the eligibility requirements, subject to the applicable exemption.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: WBPSC has stated that the date of the Screening Test will be announced shortly. The scheme and syllabus will be made available on the Commission's official website and through the Commission's Enquiry. Candidates should refer to the official scheme for the examination pattern, selection stages and other instructions applicable to this recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. What is WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: West Bengal Public Service Commission (WBPSC) has announced recruitment for Industrial Development Officer (IDO) posts in the Directorate of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of West Bengal, under Advertisement No. 15/2024.

faq.question: Q2. When will the WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026 online application start?
faq.answer: The online application process for WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026 will start on 06 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application has not been confirmed in the available announcement. Candidates should check the detailed advertisement on the official WBPSC website.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply online for WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website psc.wb.gov.in, find the Industrial Development Officer recruitment advertisement, read the eligibility conditions and complete the online application process from 06 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I download the WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026 notification?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the WBPSC Industrial Development Officer Recruitment 2026 notification from the official website at https://psc.wb.gov.in/. The recruitment is associated with Advertisement No. 15/2024, and the detailed advertisement is scheduled for publication on 05 November 2026.
